msg: warning: Variable buf is freed although not dynamically allocted!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: eef2317b9f5.c (BusyBox). Static_free alarm at line 31 ('free(buf)') when def(CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP). The tool claims 'buf is freed although not dynamically allocated,' but 'buf' IS dynamically allocated by 'buf = malloc(bufsize)' at line 26 on the non-goto path. The tool incorrectly classifies buf as statically allocated. The real underlying issue (uninitialized buf when the goto path is taken) is already correctly captured as an uninitialized_value bug by FAMILY_76 and FAMILY_77. Same incorrect static_free pattern seen in FAMILY_40/41/42.
